description: This file defines a set of utility functions for string manipulation, such as calculating string length, finding substrings, converting case, and generating tokens. It also includes compatibility functions for PHP versions prior to PHP 8.

methods.name: oc_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of the input string using multibyte string length function.

methods.name: oc_strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring within a string using multibyte string position function.

methods.name: oc_strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring within a string using multibyte string reverse position function.

methods.name: oc_substr
methods.description: Extracts a portion of a string based on offset and length using multibyte substring function.

methods.name: oc_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase using multibyte string function.

methods.name: oc_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase using multibyte string function.

methods.name: oc_token
methods.description: Generates a random token string of specified length.
